title: V1.0.5K local O:NR card release stays small, deck-legal and side-safe
steps: Load the private local O:NR runtime overlay through the catalog package.
Apply the V1.0.5K release gate and keep only the final 12 cards deck-legal.
Validate V1.0.5K Runner and Corp smoke decks and start a private match from their deck snapshots.
Install Tycho Mem Chip and Zetatech Mem Chip, then verify the Runner memory limit and visible rig metadata.
Run with Raffles into Endless Corridor, break both matching code-gate subroutines and access R&D.
Verify that mismatched breakers do not receive break actions against wall ICE.
Score Hostile Takeover and verify the public credit result, Replay and final StateHash.
Verify unrezzed V1.0.5K ICE stays hidden in Runner views until rez.
